intent.proves: No live app paragraph sits in a grid row without an item type (it would render nothing in a Swift column).
intent.scope: non-deleted paragraphs placed in grid rows

bindings.query: SELECT ParagraphID FROM Paragraph WHERE ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND ParagraphGridRowId > 0 AND ParagraphModuleSystemName <> '' AND (ParagraphItemType IS NULL OR ParagraphItemType = '')
